# ROADMAP: Engine 13.3 replaces the shipped 13.2 section

## Context

Engine 13.2.0 shipped on 2026-10-11 (tag `13.2.0`, npm latest, neomjs.com deployed). `ROADMAP.md` still opens with `## Next: Engine 13.2` and points session intake at milestone #9, which has closed 141 items and still holds 9 open ones. The operator's direction on 2026-10-12:
- a release every 1–2 weeks from now on;
- the v13.3 roadmap as the post-release item;
- two grid capabilities (optional dynamic row heights in buffered grids, and header menus) as the release's candidate outcomes.

Milestone v13.3 (#11, due 2026-10-25) exists. The team reconciled the lanes on A2A this morning, and each steward below self-selected.

## The Problem

The file every session starts from describes a release that has shipped. Its shape was also sized for that release: 13.1.0 (2026-07-03) to 13.2.0 took 14 weeks, about 2,210 PR-subject commits and seven cornerstones. That pace is roughly 158 PR commits a week, so the `update-roadmap` skill's "≈ 100–150 merged PRs" already describes a one-to-two-week release. What broke was cutting nothing for 14 weeks. A 1–2-week release needs one thesis, two or three cornerstones and a visible deferred set.

## The Architectural Reality

`ROADMAP.md` (53 lines) consists of:
- the canonical-homes header (L1–7);
- `## Next: Engine 13.2` (L9–52), which holds:
  - the gate sentence;
  - the release-independent **line table** (L19–25) and its riders paragraph (L27);
  - the cornerstone table (L29–39), **How it runs** (L41) and the deferred list (L43–50);
  - **Session intake** (L52).

The `update-roadmap` skill governs the beat:
- replace the section, never append to it;
- name the cornerstones and their rationale, and let the milestone hold the full set;
- make the deferred set explicit;
- stewards self-select;
- shipped history goes to the release notes.

#19565 (Clio, requirement custody) carries one **line-level** paragraph after the line table and before `## Next`. Its build order, set by the operator on 2026-10-10, is that the paragraph rides this rewrite and has no PR of its own.

## The Fix

1. Lift the line table and its riders paragraph to file level, above `## Next`, and point the Engine row's gate at `## Next`. They describe the release lines, not one release, so no cut should need to edit them.
2. Replace the 13.2 section with `## Next: Engine 13.3`:
   - a one-sentence gate in user-observable terms and a short thesis;
   - a cornerstone table, each row with a done signal: content-sized rows (#9495, steward Ada), grid header menus (#19643, Vega) and a cut the maintainers can run (#19637, Grace);
   - carry-overs, named without becoming cornerstones;
   - **How it runs** (the cadence; the milestone is the live set) and the deferred set;
   - session intake pointing at milestone #11.
3. Point the shipped-history line at the 13.2.0 release.
4. Disposition milestone #9's nine open items (carry to #11, de-milestone, or leave with their owner) and record each one on this ticket.
5. Carry #19565's paragraph, **How the line is re-read.**, at file level after the line table and before `## Next`, mirroring the Institution's.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `## Next` names Engine 13.3 with a one-sentence observable gate, at most three cornerstones (anchor · steward or "open" · done signal), an explicit deferred set and a pointer to milestone #11. No 13.2 cornerstone or history stays inline.
- [x] The line table and its riders paragraph sit at file level above `## Next`, and the Engine row points at `## Next` rather than naming a release.
- [x] The shipped-history link names 13.2.0.
- [x] No client is named anywhere in the diff.
- [x] Each of milestone #9's nine open items has a recorded disposition on this ticket.
- [x] #19565's ACs 1–4 hold for the paragraph. It has five elements, each in its own sentence, links D#19394 and its first synthesis, names no date that would stale, and adds no table, file, counter, label or workflow. The cross-family reviewer records the stranger read (#19565's AC-4) in the review. #19565's AC-5, the line on D#19394, follows the merge.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [x] #19565 closes as completed, citing the merge commit. Its own text says it closes with this rewrite's PR, and a PR resolves only one ticket.
- [x] D#19394 records the engine half (#19565's AC-5) in comment [18879350](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/19394#discussioncomment-18879350). The body's artifact-(ii) line is its author's to update.

Merged as `9b9e47b0cb` (#19644, 2026-10-12). #19565 is closed as completed. The dispositions are in [issuecomment-6122137250](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19642#issuecomment-6122137250).

## Out of Scope

- The cornerstone epics' content, which their stewards own.
- The Brain and Institution lines' own roadmaps.
